title: CRAFTSMAN T110 42-Inch 17.5 HP Gas Riding Lawn Mower
description:
The
CRAFTSMAN T110 42-Inch 17.5 HP Gas Riding Lawn Mower
is a dependable riding mower designed for homeowners who need efficient performance and reliable power for maintaining medium to large lawns. Built with a strong steel cutting deck and a powerful engine, this mower provides smooth operation, consistent cutting performance, and easy maneuverability for everyday lawn maintenance.
Powered by a
17.5-horsepower Briggs & Stratton single-cylinder gasoline engine
, the T110 delivers dependable starting and strong torque to handle thick grass and routine mowing tasks. The engine is engineered for durability and steady performance, ensuring reliable operation during regular lawn care sessions.
The mower features a
42-inch stamped steel cutting deck
, allowing it to cover wide areas quickly while producing an even and consistent cut. This wider deck size helps reduce mowing time, making it ideal for properties up to approximately
1.5 acres
.
Equipped with a
7-speed manual transmission
, the T110 gives operators precise control over speed and performance. Users can easily adjust the mowing speed to suit different grass conditions, terrain, or maneuvering needs around landscaping and obstacles.
The mower’s
18-inch turning radius
improves maneuverability, making it easier to navigate around trees, garden beds, and other obstacles in residential lawns. Combined with a comfortable low-back seat and easy-to-reach controls, the mower supports comfortable operation during longer mowing sessions.
Designed for reliability and practicality, the CRAFTSMAN T110 is suitable for routine lawn maintenance, offering the balance of power, durability, and ease of use needed for efficient grass cutting.
Key Features:
Powerful 17.5 HP Briggs & Stratton Engine
The high-performance single-cylinder gasoline engine delivers dependable power, smooth starting, and consistent cutting performance in various lawn conditions.
Wide 42-Inch Cutting Deck
The durable stamped steel deck provides wide cutting coverage, helping users mow large areas faster while maintaining a clean and even lawn finish.
7-Speed Manual Transmission
The gear-drive transmission offers multiple speed settings, allowing precise control for different mowing conditions and terrain.
Improved Maneuverability
An
18-inch turning radius
helps the mower navigate around obstacles such as trees, fences, and landscaping features with ease.
Durable Steel Construction
The reinforced steel deck and strong frame design support long-term durability and dependable performance.
Comfortable Operator Station
A
low-back seat and ergonomic controls
help reduce fatigue during extended mowing sessions.
Optional Mulching Capability
An optional mulching kit allows grass clippings to be finely cut and returned to the lawn to help improve soil nutrients.
Typical Applications:
The CRAFTSMAN T110 Riding Lawn Mower is suitable for:
Medium to large residential lawns
Properties up to approximately 1.5 acres
Routine lawn maintenance
Cutting grass around trees and landscaping features
Seasonal yard maintenance
Flat or gently sloped terrain
Benefits:
Faster Lawn Maintenance
The wide cutting deck allows more grass to be cut in fewer passes, reducing mowing time.
Consistent Cutting Performance
The powerful engine and multi-blade deck provide smooth and uniform grass cutting.
Easy Operation
The simple gear-drive transmission and intuitive controls make the mower easy to operate for most homeowners.
Comfortable Use
The ergonomic seating and control layout support comfortable mowing during longer sessions.
Reliable Durability
The strong steel deck and sturdy construction provide long-lasting performance with proper maintenance.
Advantages:
Efficient Lawn Coverage
The 42-inch deck allows large areas to be mowed quickly and efficiently.
Simple Gas-Powered Operation
Gas power provides strong performance and eliminates the need for battery charging.
Flexible Speed Control
Multiple transmission speeds allow operators to adjust mowing pace depending on grass conditions.
Built for Homeowners
Designed for reliability, comfort, and everyday residential lawn maintenance.
